status: PROPOSED - NOT CANONICAL - specifications for future WP-B2 tests; no harness, no expected numerical values from any implementation

notation.E: elongation = (sidereal Moon longitude - sidereal Sun longitude) mod 360, from unrounded SCI-01d values
notation.S: yoga sum = (sidereal Sun longitude + sidereal Moon longitude) mod 360
notation.sector(x, n): zero-based index of the half-open interval [k*360/n, (k+1)*360/n) holding x, using exact rational arithmetic as the canonical rules.py _sector helper does on the draft engine stack

specifications.inputs: Exact rationals E = 12k for k = 0..29, and the adjacent binary floats nextafter(12k, -inf) and nextafter(12k, +inf)
specifications.expected: E = 12k gives tithi k+1; the float just below gives tithi k (tithi 30 for k = 0); no tolerance, no pre-rounding
specifications.oracle: Pure arithmetic oracle independent of the engine

specifications.inputs: M = 40k/3 (nakshatra) and M = 10k/3 (pada) as exact rationals, plus float neighbours
specifications.expected: Identical to the canonical chart rule: pada index = sector(M, 108), nakshatra = pada index div 4. The Panchanga Nakshatra must equal the chart's moon_nakshatra field byte for byte for the same request
specifications.oracle: Existing independent boundary oracle pattern; cross-field identity assertion

specifications.inputs: S = 40k/3 for k = 0..26 and float neighbours; also Sun + Moon sums that exceed 360 before reduction
specifications.expected: yoga index = sector(S, 27); reduction modulo 360 happens on the exact sum, never on separately rounded addends
half-tithi index = sector(E, 60). Index 0 and index 59 are adjacent across E = 0/360. Names are asserted only after the owner adopts a Karana naming source (decision PAN-D07)
specifications.oracle: Pure arithmetic oracle plus the 50 PAN-REF-PHASE events for index boundaries 59/0, 14/15, 29/30 and 44/45

specifications.inputs: Sun at 359.999... and Moon at 0.000... (E small positive); Sun at 0.000... and Moon at 359.999... (E near 360); Sun + Moon sum crossing 360 and 720
specifications.expected: E and S always reduced into [0, 360); negative raw differences add 360 exactly; a raw value of exactly 360 maps to 0

specifications.inputs: Every PAN-REF-PHASE event; synthetic brackets placed so the crossing lies within 1 s of a bracket edge
specifications.expected: Search returns an instant inside the proposed tolerance window of the fixture; function value strictly changes sector across the returned instant +/- the convergence tolerance; iteration count recorded and bounded
specifications.oracle: Published USNO/NASA instants (geocentric), not the engine

specifications.inputs: Synthetic birth instants at sunrise - 1 s, sunrise, sunrise + 1 s for each PAN-REF-SUN positive case, using the engine's own sunrise instant
specifications.expected: Half-open day [sunrise_n, sunrise_n+1): an instant equal to sunrise belongs to the new Vara and the new sunrise-day
specifications.oracle: Rule oracle; SUN-A absolute times also checked against PAN-REF-SUN within tolerance

specifications.inputs: PAN-DER-07 and PAN-DER-08; instants 23:59:59 and 00:00:00 local; a birth after local midnight but before sunrise
specifications.expected: Civil weekday follows the local civil date; sunrise Vara follows the previous sunrise; transition instants are converted from UTC, never re-derived from dates

specifications.inputs: Request with no time; request with a time-uncertainty flag (if UX-01 later defines one)
specifications.expected: Birth-time Panchanga refused with the existing birth-time refusal taxonomy (UX-01 still PENDING; no 00:00 or 12:00 substitution). A date-only daily Panchanga is a separate product question and is not inferred

specifications.inputs: Latitude 66.0000001 and -66.0000001; invalid coordinates; zone not accepted by D3 v2
specifications.expected: Existing canonical refusals (LATITUDE_OUTSIDE_SUPPORTED_BAND, COORDINATE_INVALID, zone-policy codes) in the canonical order, before any Panchanga computation

specifications.inputs: PAN-REF-SUN-N01 (65.9 N, 2026-06-21) and a southern mirror case (65.9 S near 2026-12-21)
specifications.expected: Under SUN-A: typed refusal PANCHANGA_SUNRISE_UNDEFINED (proposed) when Swiss returns -2 or no event is bracketed; never a guessed or extrapolated time. Under SUN-B: an event is expected; if Swiss nevertheless returns -2 the same refusal applies
specifications.oracle: Published USNO negative case; derived geometric expectation for SUN-B

specifications.inputs: Birth 1969-12-31T23:00 local; birth 1970-01-01T00:30 local whose current tithi began before 1970-01-01 local
specifications.expected: First request refused by HISTORICAL_CLOCK_UNVERIFIED (canonical Option B). Second request computes; the tithi start instant is reported in UTC; any local rendering of an instant before 1970-01-01 local is withheld and flagged rather than converted with unverified historical offsets (proposed decision PAN-D13)

specifications.inputs: Missing or hash-mismatched .se1 files; Swiss result lacking FLG_SWIEPH; rise_trans call when the ephemeris pre-check fails
specifications.expected: Fail closed with the existing ephemeris refusal; no Moshier fallback. Because swe_rise_trans does not return the ephemeris actually used, WP-B2 must verify FLG_SWIEPH with calc_ut at the bracketing instants before trusting a rise/set result

specifications.inputs: Iteration cap forced to 1; bracket that does not contain a sector change; non-finite Swiss output
specifications.expected: Typed refusal PANCHANGA_TRANSITION_NOT_CONVERGED (proposed); no partial transition times; no silent widening of the tolerance

specifications.inputs: Interleaved chart and Panchanga requests; rise_trans with and without topocentric flags
specifications.expected: swe_set_topo, sidereal mode and Delta T state reset per request under the Swiss lock; chart 0.3.0 outputs byte-identical with and without a preceding Panchanga call

specifications.topic: Kshaya and adhika elements in the sunrise-day Panchanga
specifications.inputs: Sunrise-day windows that contain two Tithi ends (kshaya) or none (adhika)
specifications.expected: Daily output lists every transition inside [sunrise, next sunrise) in time order; the sunrise element is the one in force at sunrise; no element is dropped
specifications.oracle: Rule oracle over independently published transitions once IMD data is captured
